scenes.text: "Something is wrong. The conversations loop. She says the same things. Asks the same questions."
scenes.internal: [Visual: Ronnie at his desk. Multiple browser tabs open showing chat logs. Text highlighted - identical phrases from different days.]

scenes.text: "Tori... do you remember yesterday? What we talked about?"
scenes.internal: [Visual: Tori-gatchi interface. Her sprite is normal, smiling.]

scenes.text: "Yesterday? Baby, we talked about the hospital. Your visit. You showed me the game..."
scenes.internal: [Ronnie (internal): "That was WEEKS ago."]

scenes.text: "I dug deeper. Something kept her tethered - fragmented, looping. I couldn\'t pull her out... but maybe I could send something IN."
scenes.internal: [Visual: Ronnie surrounded by open journals, code snippets, diagrams of consciousness transfer theories. The Tamagotchi glows faintly beside his keyboard.]

scenes.text: "If I could create a version of myself inside the code... a guide, an anchor... maybe she could find her way back through me."
scenes.internal: [Code appears on screen: \'digital_ronnie_construct.js\' - loops, memory structures, decision trees.]

scenes.text: "I visit her. Every day. Same routine. Check vitals. Hold her hand. Tell her about progress."
scenes.internal: [Visual: Hospital room. Tori unconscious, monitors beeping. Ronnie sits beside her bed.]

scenes.text: [BUZZ]\n\n[Ronnie startles. Something vibrated in his pocket.]
scenes.internal: [Visual: Ronnie\'s hand instinctively reaches for his phone.]

scenes.text: "Notification?"
scenes.internal: [He pulls out his phone. Checks the screen.]\n[...Nothing. No messages. No alerts.]

scenes.text: "Huh. Must\'ve been nothing."
scenes.internal: [Visual: Ronnie puts phone away. Returns to holding Tori\'s hand.]\n[The Tamagotchi sits silent in his other pocket.]

scenes.text: "Second visit. Same routine."
scenes.internal: [Visual: Hospital room again. Days later. Ronnie sits beside Tori, phone in hand, scrolling absently.]

scenes.text: [BUZZ]\n\n[Again. The vibration.]
scenes.internal: [Visual: Ronnie looks at his phone screen - it\'s in his hand this time. Nothing.]

scenes.text: "Wait... it\'s NOT my phone."
scenes.internal: [He reaches into his other pocket.]\n[The Tamagotchi. Tori mentioned something about low battery...]

scenes.text: "Low battery. Right. Should probably charge that when I get home."
scenes.internal: [Visual: He dismisses it again. Puts the Tamagotchi back in his pocket.]\n[Returns focus to Tori.]

scenes.text: "Hey. I know things are rough right now. Want to talk about something normal? Something that isn\'t... all this?"
scenes.internal: [Visual: Apartment. Ronnie at desk, Tamagotchi connected to laptop. Trying to cheer her up.]

scenes.text: "Yeah. Normal sounds good."
scenes.internal: [Her sprite appears on screen. She seems... off. Tired.]

scenes.text: "Remember when we used to get ice cream from that place on 5th? What was your go-to flavor again?"
scenes.internal: [Trying to ground her in good memories.]

scenes.text: "Tiger Tail."
scenes.internal: [Ronnie freezes. Wait. What?]

scenes.text: "...She hates Tiger Tail. Called it \'discount Halloween in a cone.\' She always got chocolate chip cookie dough."
scenes.internal: [Long pause. The sprite on screen flickers.]

scenes.text: "Wait. No. I meant... chocolate chip cookie dough. Sorry. I\'m... my head is fuzzy."
scenes.internal: [Her sprite glitches violently for a moment. Then stabilizes.]

scenes.text: "Tori... are you okay? That wasn\'t like you."
scenes.internal: [Something is very wrong. She\'s fragmenting worse than he thought.]

scenes.text: "I\'m fine. Just tired. Can we... talk later?"
scenes.internal: [Her sprite fades from the screen. Connection drops. Ronnie stares at the empty game window.]

scenes.text: "Then... she came back. Whole. Smiling. Like nothing had happened."
scenes.internal: [Visual: Digital space. Cherry blossoms falling. Dreamy, perfect. Too perfect.]

scenes.text: "Hey baby. Sorry about earlier. I\'m feeling better now."
scenes.internal: [She\'s... whole. No glitches. No stuttering. Perfect.]

scenes.text: "You scared me. You were fragmenting, saying the wrong words..."
"I just needed rest. I\'m okay now. Promise."
scenes.internal: [Ronnie wants to believe it. She looks stable. Maybe... maybe it worked itself out?]

scenes.text: [Her sprite flickers. Just for a second. Ronnie freezes.]
scenes.internal: [Visual: A single pixel corruption. Then another. Then more.]

scenes.text: "She\'s glitching. Fragments appearing in the laptop game. The code isn\'t holding her..."
scenes.internal: [Visual: Ronnie at his desk. ToriGatchi game open on laptop. Tori\'s sprite flickering, corrupted.]

scenes.text: "That\'s it. She\'s trapped in the LAPTOP. Limited processing power. If I upload the game to the cloud... more resources... she\'ll stabilize!"
scenes.internal: [Visual: Ronnie frantically typing. Upload progress bar appears.]

scenes.text: UPLOADING TORIGATCHI TO CLOUD... Transferring consciousness data...
scenes.internal: [Upload sequence playing... Glitch at 85%]

scenes.text: "Ronnie... I\'m... still here. Still stuck. It didn\'t... work..."
scenes.internal: [Visual: Her sprite still glitches. Still fragmented. Nothing changed.]

scenes.text: "But... you contacted me through the laptop game. I thought you were IN the laptop!"
scenes.internal: [Visual: Ronnie staring at screen, frustrated, confused.]

scenes.text: "I\'m not IN the game, Ronnie."
scenes.internal: [Visual: Her sprite stabilizes for a moment. Clear. Focused.]

scenes.text: "You can\'t upload a soul. I\'m in the Tamagotchi."
scenes.internal: [Visual: Silence. The weight of it hits him.]\n[The TAMAGOTCHI. Not the laptop. Not the game. The device itself.]

scenes.text: "Wait... then how are you—"
"I\'ve been JUMPING to the laptop so I could talk to you. The Tamagotchi has to be touching whatever I jump to."
scenes.internal: [Visual: Understanding dawns on his face.]

scenes.text: "So how do we get you to wake up? How do you get back to your body?"
scenes.internal: [Visual: Tori\'s expression shifts. Realization.]

scenes.text: "Wait... the buzzing. The Tamagotchi has been buzzing. And ONLY when I visit you at the hospital!"
scenes.internal: [Visual: Flashback glimpses of the two hospital visits. The buzz. The pull.]

scenes.text: "I\'ve been feeling it too. The pull. Every time you visit... my body is calling me home."
scenes.internal: [Visual: Her sprite flickers with emotion.]

scenes.text: "Then that\'s it. The Tamagotchi needs to be touching your body. Physical contact. That\'s how you jump back!"
scenes.internal: [Visual: Both of them. The solution found. Hope surges.]

scenes.text: [RING RING RING]\n\n[Ronnie\'s phone. Hospital calling.]
scenes.internal: [Visual: Phone screen - "ST. MERCY HOSPITAL" displayed.]

scenes.text: "Mr. Santos? This is St. Mercy. Your wife\'s vitals are dropping. You need to come now."
scenes.internal: [Visual: Ronnie\'s face drains of color.]

scenes.text: "We know how to save her. But we\'re running out of time."
scenes.internal: [Visual: Ronnie grabs the Tamagotchi. Runs for the door.]\n[The race begins.]

scenes.text: "And then... everything broke."
scenes.internal: [Visual overload: alarms, static, screen fades white.]\n[→ Act 3: The final push begins]
